record.paper_title: Model Theory of Tame Valued Fields and Beyond: Recent Developments and Open Questions
record.context_brief: Decidability of Q_p(zeta_{p^infty}), Q_p(p^{1/p^infty}), Q_p^{ab}, and their positive-characteristic analogues
record.original_question: Let p be a prime. Consider the following valued fields with their canonical p-adic (or t-adic) valuations: (a) Q_p(zeta_{p^infty}), the totally ramified extension of Q_p obtained by adjoining all p^n-th roots of unity; (b) Q_p(p^{1/p^infty}), the totally ramified extension of Q_p obtained by adjoining a compatible system of p^n-th roots of p; (c) Q_p^{ab}, the maximal abelian extension of Q_p; (d) F_p((t))^{1/p^infty}, the perfect hull of the Laurent series field F_p((t)) over the field F_p with p elements, with its t-adic valuation; (e) F_p^{ac}((t))^{1/p^infty}, the perfect hull of the Laurent series field over the algebraic closure F_p^{ac} of F_p. Here L_val denotes the language of valued rings, and L_val(t) denotes L_val enriched with a constant symbol for the element t. Are the fields Q_p(zeta_{p^infty}), Q_p(p^{1/p^infty}), and Q_p^{ab} decidable in the language L_val? Are F_p((t))^{1/p^infty} and F_p^{ac}((t))^{1/p^infty} decidable in L_val, or even in L_val(t)?

evidence.quote: Open problem 3: Are Q_p(zeta_{p^infty}), Q_p(p^{1/p^infty}) and Q_p^{ab} decidable in L_val ? Are F_p((t))^{1/p^infty} and F_p^{ac}((t))^{1/p^infty} decidable in L_val or even L_val(t)? Here F_p^{ac} denotes the algebraic closure of F_p.

artifact.status_search_result: Kartas (arXiv:2001.04424, "Decidability via the tilting correspondence", 2020/2022) establishes relative decidability via tilting: full decidability of Q_p(ζ_{p^∞}) and Q_p(p^{1/p^∞}) is reduced to that of F_p((t))^{1/p^∞}, and decidability of Q_p^{ab} is reduced to that of F_p^{ac}((t))^{1/p^∞}. Some unconditional existential-decidability results are obtained, but the full decidability of these fields (in particular of the perfect hulls in characteristic p) remains open as of the cited surveys.

status_evidence.title: Decidability via the tilting correspondence
status_evidence.snippet: We prove relative decidability results for perfectoid fields and their tilts, reducing decidability of Q_p(ζ_{p^∞}), Q_p(p^{1/p^∞}), Q_p^{ab} to characteristic-p analogues.
status_evidence.claim: Decidability of Q_p(ζ_{p^∞}), Q_p(p^{1/p^∞}), Q_p^{ab} reduces via tilting to decidability of perfect hulls of F_p((t)) and F_p^{ac}((t)); the latter remain open.
